sentences.text:
Today again on repeated calls, nobody has responded on behalf of respondent No.2, as such this petition is being heard in absence of respondent No.2.
--1-- W.P. (Cr.) No. 533 of 2023 3.

The prayer in the writ petition is made for quashing of the entire criminal proceeding including the order taking cognizance dated 07.02.2023 arising out of Complaint Case No.9240 of 2022 pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad.

entities.text: Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 4. The complaint case was lodged alleging therein that the complainant is the husband of Zeenat Khan and has a daughter from the marriage.
The complainant alleged that Zeenat Khan is a quarrelsome lady moreover she was not at all happy with the marriage with the complainant.
It has been further alleged that on 21.01.2022 some of the accused persons were seeing fighting with the mother of the complainant and were also trying to outrage her modesty.
Thereafter, it has been further alleged that wife of the complainant packed her bag and was about to leave with the other accused persons.
She said that she was no more interested in living with the complainant.
That Zeenat took along with her jewellery worth Rs.3 lakhs and cash Rs.55,000/- Zeenat while taking away the said articles had promised to return the same.

It has been further alleged that when the complaint went to his in-laws place for return of the money and article, the accused persons refused to return the same, instead abused and assaulted the complainant and warned him not to come again.
In the meantime, it is alleged that he was served with notice for divorce by the local religious body wherein the complainant appeared and refused to grant divorce.
The complainant met the Mufti and prayed not to allow severance of matrimonial tie between him and Zeenat as the life of their daughter would be doomed.

Thereafter, it is alleged that when the complainant went to his in-law's place for Bidai of his wife he was informed that Zeenat was no more his wife and the complainant found that a fabricated document was created in this regard and furthermore the accused persons refused to return the articles of --2-- W.P. (Cr.) No. 533 of 2023 the complainant.
5. Learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the petitioner No.1 happens to be the wife of the complainant namely Shahbaz Khan.
She submits that so far petitioner Nos.2 and 3 are concerned they are the distant relative of the petitioner No.1 and the husband has falsely lodged the present case against the petitioners.

She submits that earlier the wife, who is the petitioner No.1 has lodged the case for maintenance which was registered as Original Maintenance Case No.176 of 2022 and the said was disposed of in light of the compromise by order dated 19.02.2024 contained in Annexure-10 brought on the record by way of filing supplementary counter affidavit.

She further submits that the petitioner No.1 has lodged the case against the complainant under Section 498A of the IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act which was registered as G.R. Case No.580 of 2023 on the basis of compromise by the judgment dated 02.04.2024 the husband was acquitted.
She submits that now she has got instruction that the petitioner No.1 and complainant are residing together.
She further submits that maliciously the present case has been lodged against the petitioners in the form of the complaint case.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the respondent State submits that the cognizance has been taken pursuant to the complaint case filed by the husband of the petitioner No.1.

He submits that in the supplementary affidavit the order passed under Section 125 and judgment delivered under Section 498A of the IPC clearly suggests that the said case has been compromised by the complainant with the petitioner No.1.
7.

In view of the above submission of learned counsel appearing for the parties, the Court has gone through the materials on record and finds that admittedly the petitioner No.1 and complainant are the wife and --3-- W.P. (Cr.) No. 533 of 2023 husband respectively.
In the supplementary affidavit the order sheet of Original Maintenance Case No.176 of 2022 contained in Annexure-10 which was disposed of on the basis of compromise by order dated 19.02.2024.

The case lodged by the petitioner No.1 being Maraphari P.S. Case No.99 of 2022 G.R. Case No.580 of 2023 under Section 498A of the IPC was also disposed of pursuant to the compromise between the petitioner No.1 and the complainant and it was pointed out that now the petitioner No.1 and complainant are residing together.

Further petitioner No.2 and 3 are the distant relatives of petitioner No.1 and in spite of several opportunities provided to the complainant he has not appeared which clearly suggests that now he is living a conjugal life along with petitioner No.1 and intentionally he is not appearing in this case.

8. Looking into the contents of the complaint, it transpires that there are general and omnibus allegations against all the accused persons and there is nothing specific against these petitioners and if such a thing is there, the Court is required to read the things in between the lines so that any innocent persons may not be prosecuted in a criminal trial.

9. In view of the above facts, reasons and analysis the entire criminal proceeding arising out of Complaint Case No.9240 of 2022 including the order taking cognizance dated 07.02.2023 pending in the Court of learned Judicial Magistrate, Dhanbad is hereby quashed.
